description: This file implements SFP (Small Form-factor Pluggable) functionalities within the wan-manager component, including updating SFP types, registering core functions, executing SFP-related commands, and initializing the module.

methods.name: update_sfp_type
methods.description: Callback function to update the SFP type parameter in the data model based on the current SFP category and interface information.

methods.name: wanmgr_sfp_register_core_functions
methods.description: Registers the update_sfp_type function within the module's namespace.

methods.name: get_sfp_type
methods.description: Executes a function in the mod-wanmgr-sfp module to retrieve SFP details from the transceiver manager.

methods.name: sfp_module_loaded_correctly
methods.description: Returns whether the SFP module was loaded correctly during initialization.

methods.name: check_sfp_type
methods.description: Checks the current SFP type by executing a callback in the mod-wanmgr-sfp module.

methods.name: read_sfp_category
methods.description: Reads the SFP category from the mod-wanmgr-sfp module.

methods.name: mod_wanmgr_sfp_init
methods.description: Initializes the SFP module, registers core functions, and checks the SFP type at startup.
